open_gaps: leaf-page-frontmatter-icon-field (frontmatter carries an `icon` key on every content/docs/*.mdx page; docs-writing says frontmatter is `title` only, sentence case, nothing else unless there is a real reason)

leaf-page-anatomy (about.mdx, onboarding.mdx, how-we-work.mdx, values.mdx, perks.mdx do not follow the docs-writing page anatomy: no Considerations/Best Practices section, no closing cross-link to a neighbouring topic)

root-index-toc-style (content/docs/index.mdx is a hand-maintained reference-link table of contents with duplicated per-section anchors instead of the fumadocs Cards/overview style used elsewhere in the docs-writing convention; root index is allowed to be a real overview page, but this format is fragile and drifts from the source pages it links into)
